svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: About 2.6 m of 3/4 in pipe and six elbows, screwed together:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: from the pot's half coupling 60 to the right, then down 450,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: across 70, up 350 to the crown, back toward the trailer end,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: across to the centre line behind the deck, and down to 80

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: above the ground, open end pointing down.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The U holds 350 of water (a loop seal): steam in the pot cannot

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: blow out of the overflow while the vent carries a surge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drain plug under the U: drain the U with the pot (frost).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Trap stay: 40 x 6 bar from the pot's clamp band to the down-leg.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Rear clip: 6 mm plate on the rear rail end (2 x M8), arm and band.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: pour water in the pot above the mark: it runs out at the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: ground; the outlet is behind the trailer, never at the operator.
